title: Pheasant in the morning grass
summary: A pheasant looking for breakfast in a wet meadow in the Bossche Broek, early on a grey Sunday morning.
content:
A pheasant looking for breakfast in a wet meadow in the Bossche Broek, early on a grey Sunday morning. It kept its head down most of the time, and this is one of the few moments it looked up.

Sony RX10 V · f/8 · 1/13 s · ISO 250
